neighbours.label: A modal or auxiliary that hedges or projects an impersonal explanatory claim about causes or outcomes ('may arise from', 'might be explained by', 'will be generated by'), vs the same claims stated without a modal
fire: Part of the drop in crime might be explained by better street lighting in the area.
The variation between the samples may arise from the way the soil was stored.
By 2050, half of the region's heat will be supplied by pumps under the streets.
Archaeologists found tools and ash that may have been left by early hunters.
The rise in allergies may, in part, be linked to cleaner homes in childhood.
Some of the gap in test scores might be explained by longer school days abroad.
Much of the damage to the reef may arise from warmer water in the summer months.
In the next decade, most new cars in the country will be powered by batteries.
